"#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

# Workspace root directory
PROJECT_ROOT="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/.." && pwd)"
SOURCE_GEMINI_DIR="${HOME}/.gemini/antigravity-ide"
TARGET_DIR="${PROJECT_ROOT}/docs/antigravity"

echo "=== Consolidating Gemini / Antigravity Context ==="

# 1. Rename 'doc' to 'docs' if 'doc' exists and 'docs' does not
if [ -d "${PROJECT_ROOT}/doc" ] && [ ! -d "${PROJECT_ROOT}/docs" ]; then
    echo "Renaming '${PROJECT_ROOT}/doc' -> '${PROJECT_ROOT}/docs'..."
    if [ -d "${PROJECT_ROOT}/.git" ]; then
        git -C "${PROJECT_ROOT}" mv doc docs
    else
        mv "${PROJECT_ROOT}/doc" "${PROJECT_ROOT}/docs"
    fi
fi

# 2. Create target directory
mkdir -p "${TARGET_DIR}/brain"
mkdir -p "${TARGET_DIR}/knowledge"

# 3. Copy brain directory contents (transcripts, artifacts, plans)
if [ -d "${SOURCE_GEMINI_DIR}/brain" ]; then
    echo "Copying brain artifacts and transcripts from ${SOURCE_GEMINI_DIR}/brain..."
    rsync -av --progress "${SOURCE_GEMINI_DIR}/brain/" "${TARGET_DIR}/brain/"
else
    echo "Notice: ${SOURCE_GEMINI_DIR}/brain does not exist."
fi

# 4. Copy knowledge directory contents
if [ -d "${SOURCE_GEMINI_DIR}/knowledge" ]; then
    echo "Copying knowledge items from ${SOURCE_GEMINI_DIR}/knowledge..."
    rsync -av --progress "${SOURCE_GEMINI_DIR}/knowledge/" "${TARGET_DIR}/knowledge/"
else
    echo "Notice: ${SOURCE_GEMINI_DIR}/knowledge does not exist."
fi

echo "=== Done! Files copied to ${TARGET_DIR} ==="
"

"#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
Consolidates Gemini/Antigravity IDE brain and knowledge folders
into docs/antigravity/ within the project repository.
"""

import os
import shutil
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path

def main():
    project_root = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
    gemini_base = Path.home() / ".gemini" / "antigravity-ide"
    target_docs = project_root / "docs"
    target_antigravity = target_docs / "antigravity"

    print("=== Consolidating Gemini / Antigravity Context ===")

    # 1. Rename 'doc' to 'docs' if needed
    old_doc = project_root / "doc"
    if old_doc.exists() and not target_docs.exists():
        print(f"Renaming {old_doc} -> {target_docs}...")
        git_dir = project_root / ".git"
        if git_dir.exists():
            subprocess.run(["git", "mv", "doc", "docs"], cwd=project_root, check=False)
        else:
            old_doc.rename(target_docs)

    target_antigravity.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

    # 2. Copy brain
    brain_src = gemini_base / "brain"
    brain_dst = target_antigravity / "brain"
    if brain_src.exists():
        print(f"Copying {brain_src} -> {brain_dst}...")
        shutil.copytree(brain_src, brain_dst, dirs_exist_ok=True)
    else:
        print(f"Notice: {brain_src} does not exist.")

    # 3. Copy knowledge
    knowledge_src = gemini_base / "knowledge"
    knowledge_dst = target_antigravity / "knowledge"
    if knowledge_src.exists():
        print(f"Copying {knowledge_src} -> {knowledge_dst}...")
        shutil.copytree(knowledge_src, knowledge_dst, dirs_exist_ok=True)
    else:
        print(f"Notice: {knowledge_src} does not exist.")

    print(f"\n=== Successfully copied files to {target_antigravity} ===")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
"
